title: Light Computer Light Tools (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: The light computer is an instrument as much as a computer; tools are first-class pieces. The Signature extension mounts every tool on a software-defined optical bench: motorized stages and programmable modulators reconfigure the instrument per task. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
